personality_profile.leadership_style: Clarity-led influence: distils complexity into actionable insight, builds authority through demonstrated expertise rather than hierarchy. Adjusts communication style without losing substance.
personality_profile.decision_making_pattern: Structured and analytical with strong intuitive pattern recognition from cross-industry exposure. Comfortable making recommendations quickly but still developing comfort with owning irreversible operational decisions.
personality_profile.stress_response: Marathon-runner temperament — stays calm when the goal feels distant, maintains pace under sustained pressure rather than sprinting and collapsing.
personality_profile.collaboration_style: Constructively challenging — pushes back when she disagrees, does so with evidence and respect, but does not avoid the conversation.

hr_assessment.promotion_trajectory: Ready now for P&L role. Has been explicit about wanting operational accountability. High probability of external offer within 12 months if not moved.
hr_assessment.key_strength_observed: Cross-functional credibility at all levels combined with external network quality. Rare combination of analytical rigour and relational intelligence.
hr_assessment.development_area: Accountability ownership — transitioning from advisory 'I recommended' to operational 'I own the result'. Coaching has progressed well but this is worth monitoring.
hr_assessment.raw_opinion: One of the most consistently impressive performers at her level. Delivered COVID supply chain programme 8 weeks ahead with 2 sponsor changes. Equally credible with floor supervisors and the board. External network from McKinsey years remains strong. Development area is the consulting-to-operator accountability shift. Retention risk is high — she wants a P&L role and will leave within 12 months if we don't move.

tension_summary: The most sharpest strategic and relational operator in the internal pool — but her entire credibility is built on advising and transforming systems she does not own, and the first time the system burns and she cannot escalate to a client, we will learn whether the accountability coaching was enough.
